content.value: Document Type - Medical Record provides details of a patient's historical medical record, vaccination, chart of abstraction, flow sheet and patient diary. This feature allows the user to retrieve, add or modify information of a specific patient or a specific medical record document of a patient. It also provides a felicity to retrieve medical record document in HTML. The document content could be images, XML.etc.

This document class is used for supplementary medical documentation that does not directly pertain to care delivery by the practice. A document subclass is required for this document class. By default, medical record documents are created in a closed status.
Medical Record Document – Chart for Abstraction:
Documents generated prior to data abstraction to transition historical paper charts to an electronic medical record.
Used to track a variety of relevant information pertaining to a particular problem over time, e.g., relevant vitals, result analytes, medications.
Pediatric Growth Charts are parabolic curves charting a patient’s age against height and/or weight. Could be paper flowsheets scanned in by practice users.
Medical Record Document – Historical Medical Record:
Requested medical records received from patients and/or previous providers, e.g., mixed records dating prior to a patient’s practice entry or standalone medical record sections.
Any document that appears to be a "diary" or list of information provided to the client for tracking purpose, e.g., home diaries kept by patients, glucose monitoring numbers, blood pressure readings.
These documents consist of dated lists of administered vaccines. Usually a single sheet of paper with labels affixed in date order, with initials or signatures from the vaccine administer.
Note: Subclassification is necessary for this document class.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Add medical record document action note
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Creates an action note for a specific medical record document

actionnote.description: The new action note to add to the document.

errormessage.description: If there was an error with this call and SUCCESS is set to false, this field may provide additional information.

newdocumentid.description: The document ID of newly created document as a result of action of Deny-New Prescription To Follow (DNTF).

success.description: Returns true if the update was a success.

versiontoken.description: A token representing the current state of this document. Will only be set if VERSIONTOKEN was originally sent to the endpoint.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Get medical record document's action note
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Retrieves action note information of a specific medical record document

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: Number of entries to return (default 1500, max 5000)

actionnote.description: The action notes that are attached to the document.

assignedto.description: This field will describe who was assigned this document during this document action.

createdby.description: The username of the person that created this document action.

createddatetime.description: The datetime this action note was created.

patientid.description: The patient ID this document is tied to.

priority.description: Priority given for this document action.

status.description: Status given for this document action.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Add medical record document to patient's chart
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Creates a medical record document record of a specific patient

entityid.description: Identifier of entity creating the document. entitytype is required while passing entityid.

priority.description: Priority of this result.  1 is high; 2 is normal.

entitytype.description: Type of entity creating the document. entityid is required while passing entitytype.

providerid.description: The ID of the ordering provider.

departmentid.description: The athenaNet department ID associated with the uploaded document.

internalnote.description: An internal note for the provider or staff. Updating this will append to any previous notes and has a limit of 4000 characters.

attachmentcontents.description: The file contents that will be attached to this document. PDFs are recommended. Please note encrypted PDFs are not supported with document upload APIs.

success.description: Returns true/false if the operation was successful.

errormessage.description: If the operation failed, this will contain an error message.

medicalrecordid.description: The document ID of the new or modified document.

primaryEndpoints.exampleCode:
curl -X POST 'https://api.preview.platform.athenahealth.com/v1/{practiceid}/patients/{patientid}/documents/medicalrecord' \
  -F attachmentcontents=@{filename} \
  -F departmentid={departmentId} \
  -F documentsubclass={documentSubClass} \
  -H "accept: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {bearerToken}"

inputParameters.name: status

inputParameters.name: documentsubclass

inputParameters.description: By default, deleted documents are not listed.  Set to list these.
inputParameters.name: showdeleted

inputParameters.name: encounterid

inputParameters.description: Number of entries to return (default 1500, max 5000)
inputParameters.name: limit

assignedto.description: Person the document is assigned to

createddate.description: Date the document was created. Please use createddatetime instead.

internalnote.description: The 'Internal Note' attached to this document

receivernote.description: External note sent to the receiving facility

tietoorderid.description: Order ID of the order this document is tied to, if any

appointmentid.description: The appointment ID for this document.

documentroute.description: Explains method by which the document was entered into the AthenaNet (INTERFACE (digital), FAX, etc.)

code.description: The code indicating why the order was not given.

codeset.description: The codeset that the code belongs to.

description.description: The plaintext description of the reason the order was not given.

declinedreason.description: List of codes indicating why the order was not given. If this field is not present, the order was not declined. If the array is empty, no reason has been chosen.

documentsource.description: Explains where this document originated (e.g. ENCOUNTER, PORTAL, etc.)

documenttypeid.description: The ID of the description for this document

medicalrecordid.description: The primary key for medicalrecord class of documents

lastmodifieduser.description: The user who last modified this document.

clinicalproviderid.description: The clinical provider ID of the performing provider

declinedreasontext.description: The user-facing description of the reason the order was not given.

externalaccessionid.description: The external accession ID for this document. Format depends on the system the ID belongs to.

internalaccessionid.description: The internal accession ID for this document. Format depends on the system the ID belongs to.

lastmodifieddatetime.description: Date/time (ISO 8601) the document was last modified

code.description: The code indicating why the order was contraindicated.

codeset.description: The codeset that the code belongs to.

description.description: The plaintext description of the contraindication reason.

contraindicationreason.description: List of codes indicating why the order was contraindicated (for vaccines only). If this field is not present, the order does not contain a contraindication reason.

href.description: The URL to get the original document.

pages.description: An array of image pages associated with this document.

contenttype.description: The content-type that will be returned by the page image call.

pageid.description: The ID to use in a call to get the page image.

pageordering.description: Within this list of pages, the ordering (starting with 1).
